gbm_population_evidence.quote: glioblastoma multiforme, cervical cancer; large cell neuroendocrine tumor of lung

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Tarlatamab: Tarlatamab will be administered at a step-up dose of 1mg on Cycle 1 Day 1

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Subjects who progressed or recurred after at least one line of therapy and are considered treatment refractory per standard of care.

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Tarlatamab Monotherapy Cohort: If the sequential safety endpoint is not met, then the study will proceed to another de-escalation phase, where 10 patients will receive tarlatamab alone.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: bispecific T-cell engager directed against DLL3

source_quote.quote: DLL3+ (≥1% by IHC) Note: If patients are DLL3 negative per IHC but have a DLL3 prevalant tumor type, they will be allowed to enroll on the study.

flag.reason: DLL3 positivity is one of several alternative routes to eligibility; DLL3-negative patients with a DLL3-prevalent histology (including GBM) may enrol, so it may not be a true entry requirement.

coder_notes: Basket of solid tumours (GBM named in conditions and inclusion list). Radiotherapy is in the experimental arms (so regimen combination) but not listed as an agent; tarlatamab is the only investigational drug. Tarlatamab role is monotherapy in the experimental sense (sole investigational agent), per manual C1.
